# US-003 — Dashboard shell, Overview, and Empty state

**Story ID:** US-003  
**Priority:** P1  
**Tasks:** T-006 (UI), T-007 (tech wiring)  
**Status:** Shipped (QA PASS)

## Who uses this and why

Every user who opens the dashboard URL sees the shell and lands on the Overview.
This story produces the persistent navigation chrome (rail and top bar) that
frames every view, the Overview that gives an at-a-glance project health snapshot,
the theme toggle, the ⌘K palette entry point, and the empty state that greets
users on a fresh project — so there is never a blank or broken screen.

## What it does

### Shell (`lib/dashboard/app/shell.js`)

The shell renders two persistent elements:

- A **264px left rail** containing: a workspace switcher button, six view nav
  links (Overview · Graph · Board · List · Sprints · Activity), a Filters section
  (Status dropdown: All / Done / In Progress / Blocked; Type checkboxes: Epic /
  Feature / Story / Task / Spec), and a "Live — watching .planr/" indicator with a
  pulsing ring animation.
- A **56px sticky top bar** containing: a hamburger button (mobile only),
  breadcrumb, ⌘K search field (opens the command palette), "Agile + Spec" mode
  chip, live badge, theme toggle (light default, `.dark` class toggles), export
  button, and a notifications bell.

The shell emits two custom events that other modules listen to without hard-wiring
dependencies: `planr:mode-change` (from the mode chip) and `planr:theme-change`
(from the theme toggle). All icons are inline outline SVG using `currentColor` and
a 1.6 stroke width — no emoji, no icon CDN.

### Hash router and theme persistence (`lib/dashboard/app/main.js`)

`main.js` is the client entry point. It calls `renderShell(root)`, then listens
for `hashchange` events and calls `hashRouter()`, which dynamically imports the
matching view module (`import('./views/<name>.js')`) and mounts it into the
content area. This keeps each view module code-split: only the active view's code
is loaded.

`toggleTheme()` reads and writes `localStorage.theme` and toggles `.dark` on the
`<html>` element. The stored choice is applied before the first shell paint so
there is no flash on reload.

`filterState` (`setFilter`/`getFilter`) is the single authoritative client-side
state for Status + Type filter selections. Views read it via `getFilter()` and
re-render when they receive a `planr:filter-change` event on `document`.
`cmdkDispatcher` binds the global ⌘K / Ctrl+K shortcut and the top-bar field to
open `views/search.js`.

### Overview view (`lib/dashboard/app/views/overview.js`)

The Overview fetches `GET /api/graph` on mount and renders:

- KPI tiles: total artifact count, done %, blocked count, in-progress count.
- A segmented status bar spanning the full content width.
- A specs table with per-spec progress indicators.
- A mini activity feed showing recent change events.

When the graph returns `{ nodes: [], edges: [] }`, the Overview delegates to
`empty-state.js` instead of rendering any data tiles.

### Empty state (`lib/dashboard/app/empty-state.js`)

Displayed when the graph is empty. Contains: the planr mark, a short message
explaining the project is not yet populated, a command chip displaying
`/planr-pipeline:plan`, and a CTA button. This satisfies the spec's "honest
empty/large states" business rule: never a blank screen, always one next action.

### `/api/meta` route (added in T-007)

The server was extended with `GET /api/meta` → `{ version, planrDir, views, defaultView }`.
The breadcrumb fetches this on startup to populate the planr directory path and
plugin version chip. This is an additive implementation not listed in the spec's
FR table; it does not conflict with any spec requirement.

## Acceptance criteria (all passing)

- Shell renders a 264px left rail with workspace switcher, all six view nav links, Status + Type filters, and a live pulse indicator.
- Shell renders a 56px sticky top bar with all required elements.
- Hash routing switches views without a page reload; the active nav item is highlighted.
- Theme toggle switches light/dark; the chosen theme persists across sessions via `localStorage`.
- Overview displays KPI tiles, segmented bar, specs table, and mini feed — all bound to `GET /api/graph`.
- KPI counts match `/planr-pipeline:status` numbers for the same project.
- Empty state is shown when the graph is empty; shows the planr mark, a message, `/planr-pipeline:plan` chip, and a CTA.
- Zero off-palette hex values in any shell, overview, or empty-state source file.
- Container-query reflow at tablet (≥768px) and mobile (<768px) is implemented in `ds.css`.
